content.title: Where are food trucks not allowed?
content.summary: On undeveloped property with unoccupied structures or unpaved surfaces In any location that would obstruct the visibility of motorists In any public park without a special event permit In any location that would obstruct parking lot circulation or access to a public street, alley or sidewalk
